objective: Add a selectable DEM blending mode based on Chandra et al. (2025) for buffer-based IDW transition between Cloud DEM and Terrarium.

assumptions.vertical_correction: No explicit datum correction; local edge differences are interpolated.

inputs.cloud_dem: Finite Cloud DEM cells sampled on selected viewer grid
inputs.support_dem: Terrarium grid for selected LoD and BBOX

method: Assign inner controls H_diff = cloud_z - terrarium_z.
Assign zero-valued outer controls around the transition radius.
IDW-interpolate H_diff in invalid Cloud DEM cells within the transition radius.
Set blended z = terrarium_z + interpolated H_diff in the transition zone.
Keep Cloud DEM inside its valid footprint and Terrarium outside the transition zone.

crs.input_crs: Inherited from viewer experiment, normally EPSG:3857

rasterization.cloud_dem_aggregation: Minimum z per cell from project pipeline
